eyebrow.en: Replay fixed suites, align two trajectories and summarize changes in tool-call matching, refusal signals and argument checks by capability.

headline.zh: 让版本比较落到具体任务信号上。
headline.en: Compare versions through concrete task signals.

sub.zh: 回放固定套件，对齐两组轨迹，按能力汇总工具调用匹配、拒答词命中和参数检查的变化。
sub.en: Replay fixed suites, align two trajectories and summarize changes in tool-call matching, refusal signals and argument checks by capability.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: YAML 套件保存任务预期。
按任务与轮次配对响应。
body.en: Pair responses by task and turn.

body.zh: 更换模型之后，单看总体回答很难指出哪类任务发生变化。regatlas 将任务预期写入套件，对每条响应计算明确的布尔信号，再按任务 ID 与轮次对齐，保留从汇总差值回到具体响应的路径。
body.en: After a model change, a general impression of answers may not reveal which tasks changed. regatlas records expectations in a suite, computes explicit Boolean signals for each response and aligns by task ID and turn, preserving a path from aggregate deltas to individual responses.

body.zh: 从自带两份响应 fixture 回放六个任务。文件名中的模型标签仅是历史 fixture 名称，无法视为真实模型测量。百分号显示的是比例之差，应读作百分点变化。
body.en: Replay six tasks from two shipped response fixtures. Model names in filenames are historical fixture labels, not verified model measurements. Percentage displays represent differences in rates and should be read as percentage-point changes.

alt.zh: 从自带两份响应 fixture 回放六个任务。文件名中的模型标签仅是历史 fixture 名称，无法视为真实模型测量。百分号显示的是比例之差，应读作百分点变化。
alt.en: Replay six tasks from two shipped response fixtures. Model names in filenames are historical fixture labels, not verified model measurements. Percentage displays represent differences in rates and should be read as percentage-point changes.

body.zh: suite 读取 YAML，replay 从服务或 RecordingClient 得到响应，breakage 计算信号并产出 Span。align 按 `(task_id, turn_idx)` 配对，delta 按 capability 聚合 candidate − baseline，report 输出 Markdown 与 JSON。这里的 signed delta 是带正负号的数值差，不是密码学签名。
body.en: suite loads YAML; replay receives service or RecordingClient responses; breakage computes signals and creates Spans. align pairs `(task_id, turn_idx)` and delta aggregates candidate minus baseline by capability. Reports contain Markdown and JSON. A signed delta is a positive or negative numeric difference, not a cryptographic signature.

alt.en: suite loads YAML; replay receives service or RecordingClient responses; breakage computes signals and creates Spans. align pairs `(task_id, turn_idx)` and delta aggregates candidate minus baseline by capability. Reports contain Markdown and JSON. A signed delta is a positive or negative numeric difference, not a cryptographic signature.

body.zh: 内置 toolcalling 与 refusal 两套任务。工具成功信号检查是否输出预期工具名，不执行那个工具；schema 检查 JSON 与 required 字段，不是完整 JSON Schema 验证。拒答由中英文词表检测。
body.en: The repository includes toolcalling and refusal suites. Tool success checks whether the expected tool name was emitted; it does not execute the tool. Schema checks cover JSON and required fields, not full JSON Schema validation. Refusal detection uses English and Chinese phrase lists.

alt.en: The repository includes toolcalling and refusal suites. Tool success checks whether the expected tool name was emitted; it does not execute the tool. Schema checks cover JSON and required fields, not full JSON Schema validation. Refusal detection uses English and Chinese phrase lists.

body.zh: 内置 toolcalling 与 refusal 两套任务。工具成功信号检查是否输出预期工具名，不执行那个工具；schema 检查 JSON 与 required 字段，不是完整 JSON Schema 验证。拒答由中英文词表检测。
body.en: The repository includes toolcalling and refusal suites. Tool success checks whether the expected tool name was emitted; it does not execute the tool. Schema checks cover JSON and required fields, not full JSON Schema validation. Refusal detection uses English and Chinese phrase lists.

body.zh: 端点变量为 `REGATLAS_<NAME>_BASE_URL`、`_API_KEY`、`_MODEL`，别名去掉非字母数字再大写。套件指定 capability、expected_tool_call 与 expected_schema.required。`--recording` 选单文件，`--recordings` 选按别名命名的目录。
body.en: Endpoint variables are `REGATLAS_<NAME>_BASE_URL`, `_API_KEY` and `_MODEL`, using the alias uppercased after removing non-alphanumerics. Suites specify capability, expected_tool_call and expected_schema.required. `--recording` selects one file; --recordings selects an alias-named directory.

note.zh: 从自带两份响应 fixture 回放六个任务。文件名中的模型标签仅是历史 fixture 名称，无法视为真实模型测量。百分号显示的是比例之差，应读作百分点变化。
note.en: Replay six tasks from two shipped response fixtures. Model names in filenames are historical fixture labels, not verified model measurements. Percentage displays represent differences in rates and should be read as percentage-point changes.

body.zh: 得到六项任务的工具匹配与参数检查差值；未执行响应中命名的工具。
body.en: Produce deltas for tool matching and argument checks across six tasks without executing named tools.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。自带响应 fixture 可离线运行；真实回放需自行配置服务与密钥。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+ and uv. Response fixtures run offline; live replay requires a configured endpoint and key.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/regatlas.git
cd regatlas
uv venv --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .

limitations.zh: 规则信号不等于整体质量或安全性；拒答增加是否为回归取决于任务预期。
limitations.en: Rule signals do not establish overall quality or safety; whether additional refusals are regressions depends on task expectations.

limitations.zh: 本示例没有真实模型调用，不能用于给任何模型排名或声称其版本退化。
limitations.en: The demo calls no real model and cannot rank models or establish a version regression.
